actual: GET /api/v1/hmm-evolution/qe-assets/{task}/{loop} returns 503 because the running RD-Agent Results API process predates the merged loop asset catalog contract. Its OpenAPI schema has only /files/{file_path}; requesting the intended /files collection falls through to a 307 slash redirect and then a 404 for an empty file path. RD-Agent PR #4 already added the exact /files collection endpoint, but the process started on 2026-07-15 and has not loaded that merged code.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: The AIstock client already requests the correct exact collection route. RD-Agent PR #4 (commit 8c6776a5c90b16a57ab68853be72726d9e5305d9) implements that route, but the active Results API process is still serving the older route table. Activate the merged RD-Agent code and verify a complete read-only catalog before closing this BUG; do not add a redirect-following or guessed-file fallback in AIstock.

events.note: RD-Agent catalog returned complete with 155 assets; AIstock HMM asset API returned 200; batch hmmb_037f84c53f9b4ae487365c17cabf0292 completed 2/2 evaluations without failure or timeout.

expected: After the RD-Agent Results API is restarted from commit 8c6776a5c90b16a57ab68853be72726d9e5305d9 or later, GET /api/v1/qe_workspace/tasks/{task_id}/loops/{loop_id}/files returns HTTP 200 with catalog_completeness and a deterministic read-only files list; the HMM QE asset endpoint then succeeds without redirects or fallback guessing.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
title: HMM QE asset catalog runtime is behind merged RD-Agent catalog contract
